# How widely is WebAuthn deployed for consumer accounts?

## 1. What the sources report

Vendor announcements give large absolute numbers but no denominator [s1]. The
specification's own adoption page lists implementers rather than users [s2].

## 2. The claim this run could not support

An often-repeated figure of "over half of consumer logins" traces back to a survey this
run could not retrieve [s7], and no other source corroborates it.

The figure is reported here because it was encountered, not because it is supported.
